description: GH-414 measurement B — identical to golden_chrome_dashboard_dataset.json except the host is declared ONLY in tracked_urls, not in match_terms. collect_chrome builds its query from match_terms + profile name (collectors/chrome.py), and the tracked-URL collectors hard-filter for claude.ai / gemini.google.com, so a generic tracked_urls host has no collector at all. Expectations below record CURRENT behavior (the whole day is lost), not desired behavior — see #414.
timezone_note: Eval sets TZ=UTC before importing the report stack so day keys and parsing match CI and local runs.
tripwire_note: No hours are expected because the visits are never collected. The zero-hour invariant is a deliberate tripwire: if #414 is fixed and this host starts producing hours, this dataset FAILS on purpose so the golden record is updated as a conscious decision rather than drifting silently.
